metadata.scenario: A regular client calls to schedule their bi-weekly acupuncture session. Category: Appointment Scheduling. Outcome: appointment_booked.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret. How can I help you today? Hi Margaret, this is Karen Lewis. I'm calling to discuss my husband's upcoming post-operative care. Hi Karen! It's great to hear from you. Can you tell me more about his surgery and the care he might need? Sure, he’s having cardiac surgery next month, and we’re looking for skilled nursing care during his recovery. Absolutely, we can assist with that. We offer post-surgery recovery care, which includes everything he might need. That sounds perfect. What does that service entail? Our post-surgery recovery care consists of a licensed nurse visiting for medication management, monitoring, and assistance as needed—usually lasting between 1 to 3 hours. Great, what’s the pricing for that? The cost ranges from $85 to $110 per visit, depending on the specific services required. Okay, that’s manageable. Can we schedule some sessions starting after his surgery? Yes, we can certainly arrange that. What date should we plan for his first session? His surgery is on the 15th; maybe the 16th would be ideal? Let’s schedule the first visit for the 16th. What time would work best for you? How about around 10 AM? Perfect, I’ll book that for you. Would you like to schedule additional visits after that? Yes, if we could do every other day for the first week, that would be great. I can set up the following visits for the 18th, 20th, and 22nd at 10 AM as well. That sounds good! Great! I have you down for the 16th, 18th, 20th, and 22nd at 10 AM. Thank you, Margaret. Will I also get a nurse assigned for these appointments? Yes, you will. I’ll ensure a qualified nurse specializes in cardiac care is assigned to your husband’s sessions. That’s reassuring, thank you! You’re welcome! Is there anything else you need assistance with today? Actually, do you offer any services for post-operative physical therapy too? Yes, we have physical therapy available as well. It could be beneficial for his rehabilitation. Would you like more information on that? Yes, please. Our physical therapy sessions range from $110 to $140 and focus on mobility and strength improvement. That sounds helpful. I might want to consider that for later. Absolutely, I can follow up with you after his surgery to see if you’d like to schedule some therapy sessions. That would be perfect, thank you! You're welcome, Karen! I’ll be in touch after the surgery. Thanks again, Margaret. Have a great day! You too, Karen! Take care.
